snippet.title: Seeking Dawn: Free to Play Edition Halloween Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Seeking Dawn: Free to Play Edition, a multiplayer survival VR game! Seeking Dawn: Free to Play Edition is a dialed back version of the official paid game. The goal is to show how to get into the swing of things and prepare players for the real adventure found in the official paid version.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/793170/Seeking_Dawn_Free_to_Play_Edition/

Full Game Review: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dg7EHl4Vufs
